item.title: Amend Act 586 Before Launching Base MHIT, Says Gopeng MP
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Gopeng MP Tan Kar Hing wants the Private Healthcare Facilities and Services Act to be amended first to control private hospital charges beyond doctor fees (facilities, drugs and consumables) and prevent "over-servicing" before launching the Base MHIT plan. item.title: New Alzheimer’s Drug In Malaysia May Slow Disease Progression By Eight Years
item.description:
Source: CodeBlue (Malaysia Health)
Lecanemab, a new Alzheimer's drug recently approved in Malaysia, shows great promise for patients with early Alzheimer’s by slowing disease progression, potentially by over eight years. The treatment doesn't cure disease, but buys time for patients. The post New Alzheimer’s Drug In Malaysia May Slow Disease Progression By Eight Years appeared first on CodeBlue .
